reasons.action: The intent explicitly specifies the temporal action: continue from the clip and end exactly on the supplied picture, so action is request-governed.
reasons.medium: No transformation is requested, and medium_decision preserves the live-action reference medium; the clip/reference therefore governs medium.
reasons.wardrobe: No wardrobe or accessory change is requested, so wardrobe remains reference-governed.
reasons.lighting: No explicit lighting instruction is present, so the reference lighting is retained.
reasons.framing: The request specifies duration and aspect only; aspect is canvas configuration, not camera framing, so framing remains reference-governed.
reasons.palette: No explicit palette instruction is present, so palette remains reference-governed.
